findings.title: Recheck and preserve the exact export child and plan before private unseal
findings.observed: The child hash is checked before public preflight. After preflight the final guard checks only A10 metadata, final review and time; it does not check the child source or generated plan. The adapter then decrypts and sends the owner token and runtime seal to a newly launched child.
findings.impact: A child replacement after successful public preflight can receive private stdin. A modified child's own verification is not a protection. A changed plan also is not detected by the adapter's final pre-unseal guard, although the genuine unmodified child later rejects it.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind exact child and generated plan hashes at the final pre-DPAPI gate and prevent reviewed execution inputs from being replaced through private child launch. Keep legacy modes and historical candidate bytes unchanged.
findings.regression: peer-adapter-source-a1.test.mjs test 10 genuinely fails MISSING_FINAL_CHILD_SOURCE_HASH_CHECK; static read also confirms missing final plan check.

verifiedProperties: Pure builder reproduces the exact candidate bytes and rejects changed predecessor or malformed child hash.
All historical parameter modes keep their order; only two export modes are added.
Only ExecuteExportsA6 gains private and runtime-seal access; ValidateExportsA6 remains public-only.
Manifest, isolated child source, A10 metadata path, final review, generated plan and current adapter hash are selected before the public preflight.
The mandatory public-only a6 --preflight has closed stdin, direct hidden execution, a 60-second wait and exact returned plan/review hash checks before private metadata validation and DPAPI.
The final guard rechecks exact metadata, exact review and reviewed start/deadline with a 90-second reserve.
The reviewed window object is passed as private JSON; the adapter derives no new expiry.
ProcessStartInfo.Arguments supplies --execute and the bounded hexadecimal hash as separate parsed command-line arguments.
The bound a6 preflight returns before stdin, and genuine execution repeats public preparation/review/adapter checks before intent or network.
Bound a6 success/error output contains explicit public summaries; the original adapter output/error block and two ACL/UTC functions are preserved byte-for-byte.

integrationFinding.title: Align target-specific plan binding and preflight result shapes
integrationFinding.detail: The common template requires review.generatedPlan.path/sha256 and proof.planSha256/finalReviewSha256. Both Health and Scheduler use review.planBinding. Scheduler --preflight currently returns planPath/reviewPath/reviewSha256 without planSha256/finalReviewSha256. These interfaces cannot satisfy the template and stop before private input.
integrationFinding.additionalIncompleteSource: The template intentionally retains four unresolved SHA markers; its named Renewal launcher tools/wave5/renew_runtime_authority_20261015_r5_a1.mjs was absent at review time.
